slot.brief: Which of the listed isomers are not resonating / which species is aromatic by Hückel's rule — e.g. rank or pick the aromatic one among cyclopentadienyl anion, cycloheptatrienyl cation, etc.

stem: Which of the following is anti-aromatic?

verdicts.working: Cyclobutadiene has 4 π electrons in a cyclic conjugated system, so it is antiaromatic (4n, n=1).

working:
Hückel rule: aromatic if (4n+2) π electrons in planar, cyclic, fully conjugated system; anti-aromatic if 4n π electrons in such a system. Cyclobutadiene has 4 π electrons (n=1) and is a planar cyclic conjugated system, so it is anti-aromatic. Benzene (6 π e⁻), cyclopentadienyl anion (6 π e⁻), and naphthalene (10 π e⁻) are all aromatic (4n+2). Hence, option C is correct.

solution: A planar, cyclic, fully conjugated system with $4n$ π electrons is anti-aromatic. Cyclobutadiene has $4$ π electrons ($n=1$), so it is anti-aromatic.
